name: hypotrail-companion
description: A study panel for a Hypotrail study, one more client of the hypotrail CLI. Stage v0 (the default) shows the recap, the plan, the deliverables, and the open proposals, read-only; every decision is made in the chat. Later stages are experimental. Off by default.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The companion runs the study's hypotrail CLI, recorded in .hypotrail/agent.json.

commands.title: Hypotrail: open the study panel (reviewer, read-only)

hypotrail.companion.enabled.description: Enable the Hypotrail study panel (experimental). Off by default; the environment variable HYPOTRAIL_COMPANION=1 also enables it.

hypotrail.companion.stage.description: Which feature set of the panel is active; each stage includes the earlier ones. v0: recap, plan, deliverables; decisions are made in the chat. v1 to v3 are experimental (ADR 0004). HYPOTRAIL_COMPANION_STAGE overrides it.

hypotrail.companion.learningLayer.description: From stage v3: glossary hovers, concept cards, and predict-before-you-look questions. Kept on this computer only.

hypotrail.companion.reviewer.description: Open the panel read-only: no control that writes to the study is shown.

hypotrail.companion.language.description: Language of the panel's own text. auto follows the study language; en is English, fr is French. The header's EN | FR toggle overrides it for this panel only. Nothing is written to the study.
